Conclusion and Future Work We studied combinatorial bandits with semi-bandit feedback. We proposed Combinatorial Thompson Sampling with a Single Seed (CTS3 ). Like CTS, CTS3 samples from the posterior of each base arm. The key difference is the sampling coupling: CTS draws these posterior samples independently across arms, while CTS3 ties them together using asingle shared random seed. √We established a polynomial mkk∗ 3 instance-dependent regret bound Õ ∆min for CTS , along with a Õ( T )-type worst case bound.
